facts.text: The class controls a Stanford Research SR830 lock-in amplifier over a GPIB connection through pyVISA
The constructor opens the VISA resource and queries '*IDN?' when it connects
Sensitivity settings run from 2 nV at index 0 to 1 V at index 26
Integration times run from 10 us at index 0 to 30 ks at index 19
An integration time is written as 'OFLT <index>' and read back with 'OFLT ?'
A sensitivity is written as 'SENS <index>' and read back with 'SENS ?'
The synchronous filter is written as 'SYNC 0' (off) or 'SYNC 1' (on) and read back with 'SYNC ?'; the upstream docstring says it should only be on below 200 Hz
The reference frequency is read with 'FREQ ?' in Hz
A data value is read with 'OUTP? <index>': X at 1, Y at 2, R at 3 and phase in degrees at 4
getRTh returns R in volts and Theta in degrees, and getXY returns X and Y in volts
